system.description:
Sometimes misfires or behaves unexpectedly. Source: BESM4e.

  • Level 1: The character must make a successful average Stat roll (TN 12) to use the Attribute.
  • Level 2: The character must make a successful average Stat roll (TN 15) to use the Attribute.
  • Level 3: The character must make a successful average Stat roll (TN 18) to use the Attribute.
